integrity: Exact proof and self-contained standard-library numerical checker included; numerical tests support but do not prove global signs.
scientific_limitations: One constant-drift one-dimensional Brownian particle, fixed reset point, local-time point sink and Poisson resetting only.
The theorem concerns the unique optimizer of mean reaction time, not target first-visit time or survival at fixed time.
The all-positive-reactivity optimum is constant only at one negative drift; the optimized mean time remains reactivity dependent.
No independent scientific audit or absolute literature-wide priority certification has been performed.
title: A reactivity-neutral drift in optimal resetting to a partially absorbing point trap
